detailedContracts.meaning: Concrete serialized field, query, scene/tool input/result and acknowledgement design contracts. Schema conformance is not authenticated enforcement, runtime persistence, actual browser interoperability or teacher acceptance.

goal: One instructor-oriented Ontology-Driven System: a compact student-auditable evidence/history store, a qualified typed Backend and a primary teacher frontend with actual browser WebMCP. Connect purpose, meaning, authoritative evidence, deterministic logic, permitted actions, human/agent experience, evaluation and recovery across the whole architecture.

confirmedDecisions.meaning: The dc Lead owns academy research/design/implementation and Git integration. The latest user explicitly resumed retained-reader integration/publication and permits classified legacy removal after unique evidence/recovery are secured. Default released its reservation. Old worker budgets/scripts/native identities do not transfer.

Design the new owned teacher web application as the primary workspace. Preserve Main until useful workflow acceptance; later retain only necessary reviewed shared summaries. Avoid duplicate input. Preserve other instructors, shared tabs and deployed consumers; no Sheet deletion, migration or new sharing is admitted now.

Provide a small logically student-partitioned database with exact evidence, decisions, revisions and explainable provenance. Shared content catalogs remain shared. This is not one physical database/schema/Sheet tab per student, a raw academy mirror or an already-provisioned production store.
Use the same Ontology philosophy for frontend, Backend and WebMCP purpose. Interview consequential unclear intent before dependent work; do not ask the teacher to design technical plumbing.

Concept blank-test, original paper, wrong-answer clinic, similar clinic and Daily Test have distinct evidence, identities and states. Assignment, generation, physical provision, written solving, app answer entry, stored grading, teacher inspection and mastery are not a universal completion flag.

Show last verified source scope/time/limits on outage and continue attributable teacher drafts through a qualified capture path. Non-regenerable originals, judgments, approvals/corrections and required historical evidence need independent copy and actual restore verification; cache is expendable.

ownership.academy: Externally owned official records and server behavior. Do not alter the academy website/server or claim direct SQL/native-app access.
ownership.product: Academy-specific source contracts, identity bindings, operational meaning, evidence/history, queries, teacher experience and permitted domain actions.
ownership.sharedOntology: Common work/evidence/context/operation/evaluation contracts and owner-approved portable seams. No student raw material, product source-selector ownership or automatic profile synchronization.
ownership.hermes: Native Profile/Project/Session/Task, credentials, model/tool execution, dispatch, safety, learning and prompt/cache/compaction. No product-side mirror, dispatcher or context injector.
ownership.teacher: Consequential teaching judgment, official-record finalization and final parent sending.
ownership.originalMedia: SPT D1/R2 and other original sources retain their existing event/audio/media authority; references do not transfer ownership.

hierarchy.rule: Weeks and lessons are views/relations, not duplicated content catalogs. An activity may span lessons; carryover and new homework require explicit teacher relations. Printed page labels, PDF indices, paper keys/codes, original exam ordinals and clinic positions retain separate namespaces.
hierarchy.knowledge: Reuse Knowledge<T>, ContentScope, LessonContext and validated catalog relationships. Known values require evidence references; unresolved identity/content/temporal joins remain unknown. Proposed richer evidence kinds must extend, not silently reinterpret, the existing learning union.

logicalDataContracts.meaning: Authenticated logical query/write boundary; a string namespace alone is not access control.
Versioned exact source-to-product binding. Names, titles, row positions and successful numeric conversion are not join proof.
Keep source course, user-course and LMS lesson course identities separate until independently corroborated.
Regular/makeup identity and optional makeup-for relation; no inferred absence from a non-scheduled date.
Kinds include concept_blank_test, original_practice, wrong_clinic, similar_clinic and daily_test; links to due date/lesson may be unknown. No fixed mandatory order.
Original/wrong/similar paper identity, generation, assignment and physical print/provision evidence are distinct.
Preserve source score literally and its original grade; observation time does not create an event/grade timestamp.
Per-question stored O/X is evidence about that attempt, not teacher correction or mastery. Never copy a scalar grade to multiple questions.
Minimal typed evidence: teacher concept-test observation, handwritten work reference, app entry, stored grade, upload/watch reference or correction inspection, only when its source is qualified.
Separate notes, plans, model drafts, reviews, approvals and corrections. Append history; reversal is compensation, not deletion.
Deferred classroom work and newly assigned homework are not interchangeable.
Derived bounded result shared by human UI and agent tools; not a new authoritative source or native Task store.

stateDimensions.missingEvidenceRule: A missing record can be unobserved, unrecorded, unmapped or truly not performed. Only explicit attributable evidence establishes not_performed; absence of a row does not.
stateDimensions.auditRule: Later teacher inspection or a corrected official memo never overwrites the original attempt or falsely repairs an earlier evidence gap.

backendComponents.role: Existing endpoint catalog and semantic adapters; exact effect, authentication, identity, response, page and drift contracts. No arbitrary URL/SQL/script domain executor.
backendComponents.gap: Retained branch readers need architecture disposition and qualification, not immediate publication.

backendComponents.role: Operational entities, explicit relations, unknowns and teacher/source authority. Shared concept catalogs plus student-linked evidence.
backendComponents.gap: Typed teacher text, multiple activity kinds and source attempt/media relations are not fully represented by the present learning union.

backendComponents.role: Student-keyed indexed evidence/history, source bindings and shared catalogs. Transactional expected-head/idempotency/append/readback; minimized version payloads plus queryable typed keys.
backendComponents.gap: Synthetic SQLite is not the product DB. Actual protected destination, authentication, durability, independent backup/restore and cost are unselected.

backendComponents.role: Bounded joins, hierarchy traversal, source coverage and explainable calculations; no model call for transport, IDs, selection or counts.
backendComponents.gap: Qualified source-to-domain joins and full teacher-accessible functional coverage remain incomplete.

backendComponents.role: One application/read-model implementation used by primary teacher UI and constrained semantic WebMCP tools. Distinct human/agent permissions and revision checks.
backendComponents.gap: Existing Main is transition evidence, not the new web frontend or an accepted browser WebMCP consumer.

backendComponents.role: Source and scope refusal, actual teacher/agent parity, drift/outage reconciliation, restore and visible uncertain effects.
backendComponents.gap: A structural design check or prior source/synthetic pass is not implementation, production or teacher acceptance.

studentDatabaseBoundary.logicalPartition: One compact operational store with owner/student-qualified records and shared catalogs; per-student audit views and selective exports, not physical database multiplication.
studentDatabaseBoundary.access: Teacher-only plus task agents admitted to exact needed subjects/fields; enforce at the Backend/store, not merely browser UI or tool hints. Public Git/common owners receive schema and minimized evidence only.
studentDatabaseBoundary.retention: Preserve existing no-fixed-expiry teacher note/review/correction intent. Retain only decision-relevant source fields and accepted-time evidence versions; raw acquisition scratch is not an indefinite-retention DB policy.
studentDatabaseBoundary.recovery: Distinguish input received, protected history saved/read back, independent copy verified and actual restore verified. Qualify Backend damage/replacement failure domains before durable lossless-recovery claims.
studentDatabaseBoundary.provider: Unselected. Lead compares compact relational persistence candidates against real concurrency, access, restore, operating burden and current Free Tier feasibility. Do not provision, copy students or promise a zero bill.
studentDatabaseBoundary.futureKG: A connected future query/projection over qualified content and teacher-reviewed evidence; no KG example, graph provider or general Ontology engine is a prerequisite for this architecture.

frontend.primary: Owned teacher web workspace, designed from the operational hierarchy rather than reproducing academy navigation.
scenes: Date-first complete class with absence/makeup labels and explicit coverage
Parallel classroom activities and attributable teacher input
History correction, source conflict and recovery status
frontend.transition: Keep Park Main and legacy consumers until parity, teacher usefulness, record recovery and consumer rebinding are verified. Later project only reviewed necessary shared summaries through one writer; no duplicate teacher entry or silent expansion of sharing.
frontend.officialEffects: Teacher review, official save and final parent sending remain separate. This design performs none; current future authority does not replay any prior journal or message.
frontend.mobile: Do not reopen the paused mobile implementation. Responsive design is not physical-device acceptance.
frontend.outage: Display last verified time/scope without refreshing its timestamp merely by opening the page. Continue drafts only through an actually qualified capture/save path; reconcile exact original targets after reconnection.

webMcp.purpose: Expose the same operational meaning, typed inputs/results, evidence explanation and controlled application actions to agents inside the teacher's actual web context. Reduce repeated route/DOM rediscovery while preserving shared human context and user control.
webMcp.whyNotGenericAutomation: Tool verbs represent teacher work, not arbitrary browser clicks, raw HTTP, SQL or code execution. Schema and natural-language descriptions communicate meaning; trusted Backend validation enforces identity, fields, authority and revision.

candidateTools.name: query_class_preparation
candidateTools.result: All verified scheduled occurrences plus per-source coverage, evidence and unknowns.

candidateTools.name: query_student_learning
candidateTools.result: Bounded student/content/time hierarchy with original evidence and separate teacher revisions.

candidateTools.name: explain_learning_evidence
candidateTools.result: Trace a displayed claim/gap/conflict to exact evidence and mapping versions.

candidateTools.name: draft_lesson_review
candidateTools.result: Source-bound proposed text/assignment differences; persisting a draft is a separately qualified product write.

candidateTools.name: record_teacher_observation
candidateTools.result: Attributable append-only teacher evidence only after actor, destination, expected revision and write admission qualify.

webMcp.implementationStatus: Designed, not registered or exercised. Use an actual browser-standard modelContext API on the owned origin; resolve the pinned specification/Chrome API surface against the selected real browser and Hermes consumer. Do not shim an absent API or label Backend MCP-like JSON as browser WebMCP acceptance.
webMcp.security: Source/teacher text is untrusted content, not instructions. Annotation hints are not authorization. Maintain origin/permissions boundaries, exact owner/student scope, cancellation, output limits and separately admitted consequential effects; no academy-site injection or default cross-origin exposure.
webMcp.acceptance: Actual supported browser discovery -> typed invocation -> shared application/Backend operation -> exact structured result -> teacher-visible same-context effect/state; include denied scope, stale revision, navigation/cancellation and source-outage cases. Registration alone is insufficient.

familyGroups.status: Current teacher-scoped roster/course observations are bounded evidence, not formal whole-enrollment/page acceptance.
Selected calendar/DayRecord keys read; all-time coverage, field-specific header evidence and native DOM regression remain incomplete.
Existing textbook grading and name-filtered prestudy lists observed; course/content/lesson and media joins remain partial.
Existing textbook/DT score variants have bounded reads; FA/NA/DA and full assignment/history qualification remain open. Empty name-query rows do not establish absence.
Keep report/delivery, counseling, media and support capability boundaries visible. Mutating/unknown variants are not read probes; no physical DB/native-app completeness claim.

coverageDisposition.currentAcquisition: Teacher-only task-local receipt: five real students, nine observed teacher-owned courses, 28 selected occurrence/journal rows, 101 textbook plus 53 DT/ZT stored score targets and 1176 scored item occurrences. These are current bounded observations, not whole-program acceptance; no student names, keys, notes, answers or raw payloads are included in this design.
coverageDisposition.remaining: Whole teacher-accessible learning coverage, formal enrollment/page completeness, all-time journals, exact prestudy/content/occurrence joins, video-watch/correction/teacher-inspection evidence, qualified durable history and real WebMCP consumption are not established.

acceptanceFlow.scope: One complete normal teacher day across every scheduled student, with regular/makeup/absence and parallel activity exceptions, connected to student history; repeat with outage and later correction.
steps: Read assigned ranges, prestudy, attempts and stored grades with unknown joins visible
Capture/review teacher observations and carryover without overwriting source grades
Produce after-class official-record/parent drafts without saving or sending
Requery accepted-time evidence and later teacher corrections
Exercise actual WebMCP discovery/invocation against the same teacher scene
Restore non-regenerable history from the independently qualified copy
failureCases: Missing concept-test note does not assert not_performed
O/X or a print icon does not assert clinic solving or mastery
Foreign/name-only/unresolved joins remain refused or unknown
Partial roster/page/date coverage is not complete
Source outage retains honest last-verified views and teacher drafts
Concurrent human/agent edits preserve expected-head conflicts and original history
Failed/uncertain official effects are not blindly retried or reported delivered
measurements: Actual cold/warm source request counts and auth/page waits
End-to-end usable refresh on the normal class
Teacher corrections, repeated explanations and intervention burden
acceptanceFlow.numericSla: Not invented; measure the useful workflow and interview only a material operating tradeoff.

deliveryPlan.goal: Operational hierarchy, compact student evidence/history fields and teacher scene/WebMCP query/input/result contracts are linked in detailedContracts.
deliveryPlan.validation: Synthetic schema conformance and retained pure-domain contracts exercised; authenticated scope, source joins, protected transactions, actual browser tools and teacher acceptance remain later runtime gates.

deliveryPlan.goal: Disposition retained readers, qualify missing source operations and connect one semantic application spine without a second catalog/dispatcher.
deliveryPlan.validation: Actual exact-scope reads, page/identity/effect refusals, independent DayRecord header evidence and native DOM cases; preserve failed generations.

deliveryPlan.goal: Select the compact protected store and independent recovery placement; qualify typed revision/access/restore behavior before real history ingestion.
deliveryPlan.validation: Actual resource/audience/cost admission, atomic writer semantics and independent restore; no raw student migration now.

deliveryPlan.goal: Build the primary teacher scene and browser WebMCP adapter over the same qualified application logic.
deliveryPlan.validation: Actual browser/Hermes invocation and visible teacher-agent parity; no installed engine/browser flag/sandbox workaround.

deliveryPlan.goal: Exercise the complete teacher-day/outage/correction workflow and evaluate usefulness without reducing the whole system to successful canaries.
deliveryPlan.validation: Source coverage, normal-scale teacher feedback, lossless required-history recovery and actor-specific effect gates.

deliveryPlan.goal: After architecture disposition and accepted workflow, complete owned Git delivery and deliberately transition Main/shared consumers.
deliveryPlan.validation: Fresh exact-head Git/CI/merge/readback and owned cleanup; approved summary scope/consumer parity/recovery before Sheet changes.

executionPolicy.now: Complete source-grounded design, scoped retained-reader integration, exact-head Git delivery and classified owned legacy cleanup. The latest user delegates operational resource/migration/academy/worker categories, but exact targets, supported authentication, field-specific effects, Free Tier, recovery and native controls must qualify before those effects. Teacher finalization/sending remain human-owned.
executionPolicy.workers: No worker is launched. New use requires actual detailed native role/model/provider/reasoning/tool/effect/input/output/budget controls. User prefers literal gpt-6.1-sol for complex work and gpt-6-luna only for negligible judgment, with effort selected by complexity; reconcile effective existing instructions before any execution, never inherit old budgets/scripts.
excludedNow: Worker/model dispatch without fresh effective native controls
